body:
Non-ibuprofen APIs 38%→45% of pharma revenue; promoters bought ~9.7 pp on open market; FII 1.7%→7.3%. ROCE only 11%; already ran ₹67→224.
Kill criteria: OPM <12% 2 qtrs; non-ibuprofen share <40%; promoter sells; debtor days >110
Caveat: sourced from public screens — no proprietary edge (lesson L1). Pledges not confirmed from NSE SAST.
